subject: Unwanted R code echo in PDF

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Unwanted R code echo in PDF
parts:
I'm converting a .Rnw file to a .tex file using knitr, and then converting to PDF. I have set echo = FALSE, but I'm still getting R code appearing in the PDF.

On the first few compiles, there is no R code in the PDF. Then after a few compiles, the source R code appears in a couple of sections at the top of the PDF. Then after more compiles, my entire source R code appears in the PDF.

Any suggestions as to the cause of the R code echoing in the PDF?
